payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_session.py::test_a_task_whose_lenses_are_handed_no_diff_records_none stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/cell/session.py. The claim was "A task whose lenses are handed no diff writes no `reviewed-diff.json`. The witness drives three such tasks, and first a clean REVIEW that writes the file through the same helpers. The three are a task that ends `PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE` before REVIEW, and one whose Gate-only cell suite aborts and ends `GATE_ERROR`. The third is one whose Gate-only cell applies the patch while its critic cell refuses it, ending `EXHAUSTED`. The clean REVIEW's spec is not stacked, and its file's `tree_base` is that spec's `base_sha`.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_consumes.py::test_run_task_refuses_an_unresolved_consumed_entry_before_the_cell, tests/test_consumes.py::test_consumed_entries_resolve_at_the_tasks_tree_base, tests/test_consumes.py::test_saffron_cell_exits_1_on_a_consumes_refusal, tests/test_consumes.py::test_an_unreadable_consumed_entry_refuses_the_task_and_names_it, tests/test_removed_name_readers.py::test_run_task_refuses_a_removed_name_read_outside_touches_before_the_cell, tests/test_removed_name_readers.py::test_readers_are_read_at_the_tasks_tree_base_with_its_own_policy, tests/test_removed_name_readers.py::test_a_spec_with_no_removes_or_no_touches_never_looks_for_readers, tests/test_session.py::test_a_cell_the_runtime_cannot_exec_in_exports_its_patch_from_the_volume, tests/test_session.py::test_a_volume_that_cannot_be_read_either_ends_the_export_once, tests/test_task.py::test_gate_zero_refuses_a_recorded_spec_text_before_its_cell, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
